name: MineColonies Fabric 26.2 (Unofficial)
description: An unofficial port of MineColonies to the Fabric loader on Minecraft 26.2. MineColonies is a colony simulator within Minecraft! There are numerous types of workers, and each worker has its own type of hut, letting you build a busy and vibrant village/town/city/colony. There is no coded limit to the number of NPC's at your disposal, so you can create a small, efficient village dedicated to a particular type of worker or a sprawling metropolis with hundreds of workers. It's entirely up to you! The mod itself is the work of the LDT Team; this port is not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by them, so please do not send them reports about this build.
